Order:

This writ petition is filed with the following prayer;
"to issue a writ, order or direction particularly Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents to initiate proceedings under Land Acquisition Act to acquire the land of petitioner in Plot No.32 an extent of 320 Sq Yards equivalent to 268. 80 Sq Meters situated in Sy.No.237 and 258 (old) and Sy No.828 and 827 (new), Komatipally Village of Waddepally, Hanamkonda Mandal, in which the respondents have laid the pipe line to take water from Devadula Project to Wadepalli Filter Bed Hanamkonda and to pay the compensation or to restore possession of the land to the petitioner by removing the said pipe line".

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Municipal Administration and Urban Development.
3.

Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the absolute owner and possessor of Plot No.32 to an extent of 320 sq. yards equivalent to 268.80 sq. meters situated in Sy.No.237 and 538 (old) and Sy.Nos.828 and 827 (new) of Komatipally Village, Waddepally,
Hanamkonda, Warangal District having SK, J purchased the same through registered sale deed dated 20.02.1981.

He submits that the petitioner has constructed the compound wall and a watchman quarter in accordance with the sanction plan, but the respondents highhandedly destroyed the said compound wall and room and laid the pipe line in the middle of the plot without resorting to acquisition proceedings and payment of compensation, which is illegal and arbitrary and requested to allow the writ petition.

4. Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition based on the counter averments submits that the respondent has taken up 1400 mm dia Mild Steel pipe line carrying drinking water from the filtration plants at Waddepally to the School of Distance Learning and Continuing Education junction to feed Kakatiya University Filters and Desaipet Filters vide G.O.Ms.No.349 M.A & U.D.
(A1) Department dated 23.05.2007.

He submits that the said 1400 mm pipe line laid parallel to the B. Susheela vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, Rep. By on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79509185/
1 existing 762 mm dia Pre SK, J Stressed Concrete Pine Line, which laid 30 years back and passing through the middle of the land of the petitioner.

sentences.text: He submits that as the petitioner's plot is not in the approved layout plan of the Kakatiya Urban Development Authority, Warangal, and the existing 762 mm dia Pre Stressed Concrete pipe line was laid 30 years back all along the roads, the question of acquisition of land does not arise.

As per the Master Plan network with a view not to hinder or obstruct any other private property such as lands, open plots, houses whatsoever, the alignment of pipe line was chosen and fixed according to the approved master plan of Warangal city keeping all road networks.

5. Learned Government Pleader further submits that due to rapid growth of population in Warangal city, the respondents have laid additional 1400 mm dia pipe line along the existing 762 mm dia line which is all along the connecting the roads and there is no encroachment of private land or plot and as such, it is SK, J not possible to initiate land acquisition proceedings and requested to dismiss the writ petition.
6.

Having heard the submissions and perusal of the record, without going into the merits of the matter, the Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondent No.1 to conduct survey of the petitioner's land with the assistance of the Assistant Director of Land Survey and Records in the presence of the petitioner.

If the land of the petitioner is affected for formation of the pipe line, the respondents are directed to initiate the land acquisition proceedings and pay compensation to the petitioner and the entire exercise shall be completed within four (4) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
7. Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending in this writ petition, shall stand closed.
_ __ JUSTICE K.SARATH Date:09.07.2024 sj B. Susheela vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, Rep.
